API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APIPartner IntegrationsGet Permissions
Get Permissions
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/discoveryService/:id/permissions

Verifies the specified AWS account permissions using the discovery role and external ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
int32
REQUIRED

The unique identifier for the AWS account.

APPLICATION/JSON
BODY
discoveryRole
string

The IAM role associated with the AWS account.

externalId
string

The unique external ID for the AWS account.

Responses
​
default

Default response. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
SCHEMA
